title: Major Literary Prizes (Post45 Data Collective)
author_or_editor: Claire Grossman, Juliana Spahr and Stephanie Young
reliability_notes: Peer-reviewed dataset of US literary prize winners and judges (1918-2020) with Wikidata, VIAF and LCCN author identifiers; used for author discovery and prize-year verification.

title: Selected British Literary Prizes, 1990-2022 (Post45 Data Collective)
author_or_editor: Katherine Binhammer, Kanika Batra, Theo Gray and Maryse Jayasuriya
reliability_notes: Peer-reviewed dataset of winners and shortlists of major British prizes (Booker, Whitbread, Orange, T. S. Eliot, James Tait Black and others) with book titles and VIAF identifiers; 1990-2000 rows used.

title: NYT Hardcover Fiction Bestsellers, 1931-2020 (Post45 Data Collective)
reliability_notes: Peer-reviewed bestseller metadata with OCLC numbers and author authority identifiers; used for popular and commercial fiction discovery.

title: NEA Creative Writing Fellowships (Post45 Data Collective)
reliability_notes: Peer-reviewed list of National Endowment for the Arts literature fellows from 1967; used to discover minor and mid-career US writers. A fellowship is evidence of activity, not of a particular book.

title: Asian American Literary Canon (Post45 Data Collective)
reliability_notes: Peer-reviewed dataset of Asian American texts and authors ranked by instances of scholarly study, with publication years, genres and publishers.

title: Feminist Bookstore News, 1976-2000 (Post45 Data Collective)
author_or_editor: Julie R. Enszer, Salome Grasland, Cassidy Hunt and Michaela Hayes
reliability_notes: Archival article metadata from Feminist Bookstore News; used to discover feminist and lesbian small-press writers.

title: Ralph Ellison (Wikipedia)
reliability_notes: Article revision of October 2026; dates, bibliography with first-edition ISBNs and posthumous-publication history checked against Encyclopedia.com and the New World Encyclopedia.

title: Ralph Ellison (Encyclopedia.com, compiling Gale's Contemporary Authors and Contemporary Black Biography)
reliability_notes: Reproduces Gale reference entries; gives the older birth year 1914 and dates Flying Home 1997, both recorded as discrepancies.

title: Ralph Ellison (New World Encyclopedia)
reliability_notes: Independent corroboration of dates (1913-1994), the National Book Award (1953) and the 1965 Book Week poll.
